thread:
Sam (sales): Quick sync on Kyvernion POC. They sent a security questionnaire and an onboarding spec: ~1M users, initial import ~1.2M, ongoing provisioning via SCIM push (delta every ~15m), need SAML (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated), group->role RBAC, delegated admin groups, and per-subdomain domain claims (eu/us). They want a rough price + whether Hosted can handle it or we should push Dedicated/private. Legal also asked about KMS/BYOK and 12mo audit retention. Need a short list of blockers + a ballpark by EOD.

Aisha (solutions): Got it. Do they expect SCIM to be synchronous per-change or batched? And do they want our SCIM API to accept bulk operations (we support Bulk per RFC)?

Sam (sales): They prefer push and would like bulk for the initial import. Churn unknown yet, asked for guidance on churn assumptions for pricing.

Diego (eng): Operational notes: Hosted default tenant rate-limits will likely throttle a 1.2M import. If we assume 1.2M over 6 hours that's ~55k/hr (~15.3/s) — Hosted soft limit is ~100 req/s but shared; still risky. Recommend Dedicated reserved pool for ingestion with a temporary rate override during the import. Need to know average attributes size (payload bytes) and groups per user.

Priya (security): Security constraints from questionnaire: customer-managed KMS/BYOK is a hard ask for production. For POC they said they might accept our managed KMS if we provide audit logs. They also request SOC2 Type II evidence and encrypted-at-rest keys. 12mo retention for audit logs is requested — our Hosted default is 90 days; 12mo requires enterprise plan.

Alex (sales_eng): Pricing sketch: SCIM writes billed per write unit. For ballpark I can model: one-time bulk ingestion fee + per-write delta rate. If we model 1.2M initial (ingest) + steady 2k/day changes, I'll produce a table, but need churn number to be accurate. Also include dedicated pool monthly reserve price if opting for Dedicated.

Ben (legal): Note: BYOK will require KMS key exchange + ATE (attestation) steps and an updated DPA/contract amendment. Plan for ~2-3 week lead time. Also confirm whether logs need to be delivered to their SIEM or just stored by us for the retention window.

Aisha (solutions): Domain verification: we support multiple domain proofs (TXT) per subdomain. Each subdomain needs its own verification record; we can automate via API but DNS changes are on their side. Delegated admin: we map special admin groups (we recommend prefix admin: or role_admin:) to create app-level delegated admin users.

Diego (eng): SCIM recommendations: use our Bulk endpoint with chunking (100-500 ops). Include idempotency keys for resume after failures. Example request for bulk chunk: 

```
POST /scim/v2/Bulk
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:BulkRequest"],
  "Operations": [
    { "method": "POST", "path": "/Users", "data": { "userName": "anne@kyv.com", "emails": [{"value":"anne@kyv.com"}], "groups": ["eng"] } }
  ],
  "idempotencyKey": "batch-20260323-001"
}
```

Diego (eng): For the import we propose: provision a Dedicated ingestion pool sized for 25-50 req/s sustained, temp override up to 100 req/s for 8 hours, and then scale down. Also add resume tokens and a retry/backoff policy documented.

Priya (security): For POC we can offer managed KMS + enhanced logging as a compromise, but note in writing that BYOK/HSM and 12mo immutable retention are gated features requiring enterprise contract. I'll prepare a redacted SOC2 summary and list of gating items for Legal.

Alex (sales_eng): Actionable items: (1) Diego to send exact Dedicated pool sizing + ops steps and temp override procedure, (2) Aisha to draft SCIM mapping doc with group naming conventions and delegated admin pattern, (3) Priya to attach SOC2 summary + BYOK timeline and log retention options, (4) Ben to draft required contract notes for BYOK + log retention. I'll assemble a pricing ballpark after Diego's sizing.

Sam (sales): Can we ballpark now assuming their import over 6h and steady-state 500 writes/day? Give me a quick per-month delta and one-time ingest fee estimate.

Diego (eng): Quick arithmetic: 1.2M / 6h = ~55,555/hr -> ~15.4/s. Dedicated pool at 25 req/s comfortably handles that (allows headroom for spikes). One-time engineering migration support + temp override: recommend a one-time $7.5k migration fee. Delta writes at 500/day negligible per month but billed per-write; I'll provide per-write unit price from Alex. Also call out group explosion risk if groups>10k.

Alex (sales_eng): Ballpark numbers (rough): Dedicated reserved pool (small) $4k/mo, one-time bulk ingest fee $7.5k, per-write provisioning $0.002/write. With 1.2M initial + 500/day steady = initial write cost ~ $2.4k (1.2M * 0.002 = $2,400) + ingest fee + pool = first month ~ $13.9k (rough). I'll refine once Diego confirms sizes.

Aisha (solutions): I'll send the SCIM mapping doc and request sample CSV of typical user payload and group counts to size correctly. Also ask them to confirm delegated admin group names.

Ben (legal): I'll prepare DPA amendment language and note the BYOK lead time. If they need log exports to their SIEM we need to confirm format and S3 access or syslog endpoint.

Sam (sales): Thanks all. I'll push this summary to the buyer and request churn numbers + sample payload. Will loop back when they reply. :thumbsup:
